key_insight: R²-PQF enables lower-T-count PQF quantum circuits by routing runtime-inserted gates fast enough to avoid latency penalties in most cases.
engineering_relevance: Hardware-accelerated runtime routing can help surface-code quantum computers exploit PQF synthesis despite unpredictable T-state delivery paths.
method: Route gates layer by layer while the previous logical timestep executes.
Use Wavefront Breadth-First Search to find non-intersecting lattice-surgery paths to T-state factories.
Implement the router on a 500 MHz FPGA and a 2 GHz ASIC.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a 1.51 μs median logical timestep for a 300-qubit Ising Hamiltonian circuit at 2 GHz, with execution speedups averaging 1.34× and reaching 1.76× over a stalling-based baseline.
watch_item: Rare routing-window overruns remain, so median timing does not guarantee stall-free execution for every layer or workload.
paper_title: Runtime Compilation for Quantum Circuits with PQF-Enabled $R_z$ Synthesis
